so_what: tyanserg is 6-1 and has already spent 48 of his 100 FAAB, the only owner in the league who has bid seriously. Jahmyr Gibbs (aggravated ankle, "should be good") and Zach Charbonnet's return are both his, so his RB room gets deeper this week while his QB spot ranks 11th of 12.

trentonwest33 is 1-6 despite the second-best projected roster: McCaffrey's mild hamstring strain costs him the bye week and nothing more, and Jadarian Price's return from IR adds a back. A strong roster stuck at 1-6 is the owner who should be buying now, and 100 untouched FAAB says he can.

Philadelphia's backfield is the week's hard read: sbbroom's Saquon Barkley played nine snaps on Monday with a new back injury, and BrittAndTheBoys' Dameon Pierce left with an injury of his own. In a 12-team league with a thin wire, a healthy Eagles back is worth more here than in a 10-team league, and neither owner knows yet whether he has one.

BrylerAnderson (3-4, 10th of 12 in strength, worst WR room in the league) is the one owner with Lamar Jackson, who is reported likely back at Buffalo. A healthy Jackson is the biggest single-player swing in this format, because the 4-point pass TD leaves his rushing as the premium.

OrourkeP (5-2) has Puka Nacua and Davante Adams, so the Adams IR stint moves targets between two of his own players instead of costing him any. Baker Mayfield's return and Josh Jacobs back in the lead role both land on his roster too.

LaPray0814 (1-6) took the week's hardest hit: Jaylen Waddle left Week 7 hurt, though Tony Pollard's 129-yard, three-TD day and CeeDee Lamb's two scores Monday kept the lineup alive. Only tyanserg has spent real FAAB so far, so this market is still mostly unpriced.
